cost_scope: Utility includes per-hit task cost. Solver and training costs are separately measured; no compute or energy superiority is inferred.

implementation_configuration.ordinary_features: standardized full quadratic of all eight public inputs
implementation_configuration.selection: highest development analytic expected task utility

statistics.limits: Empirical percentile intervals conditional on the three frozen fits; no fitted-network population or general coverage claim.
statistics.resampling_unit: One complete paired context cluster within each fit/stratum cell
statistics.weighting: Equal strata within fit, then equal fitted seeds; identical weights in bootstrap
